title: guid
summary: Benilla's guid.rs decodes the 1.12 guid bit layout (high-16 family tags, entry bits 24-47, MO_TRANSPORT full-low-32 entry, pet-number-not-entry rule). MSUI's GuidInfo.cs is a direct port with matching constants and the same Entry() special cases including MO_TRANSPORT and the pet exclusion.

openItems.text: pet_number() extraction and its consumer CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY are absent - the one guid decode Benilla ships for pet naming has no MSUI counterpart, so pet guids can never be resolved to names
